subject: RE: Encord - Cisco Sytems Ltd. - 1-2-1 Meeting and HQ Visit Opportunity
text:
OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE - COMMERCIAL

Hi Leo

We haven’t had the chance to meet yet, but I work alongside Rohin and manage Cisco’s local relationship here in SF. I’m currently drafting a program outline for Cisco ahead of your meeting next week.

Thank you for sharing the brief overview of why Encord could be valuable to Cisco. I’ve summarized your points as follows. Could you please review and confirm if this looks accurate, or suggest any edits?

Attendees:
Leo Leclercq (Head of Sales)
Steffan Jones (GTM Team)
Nikolaj Buhl (Product Lead)
Website: https://encord.com<https://encord.com/>

Overview (Detailed):
Encord is the leading computer vision and multimodal AI data management, curation, and annotation platform, enabling teams to get high-quality models into production faster.

  *   Core Capabilities:
     *   Native video workflows that enable automation at scale for annotation and labeling.
     *   Enterprise-grade curation through embeddings, metrics, and metadata for efficient dataset management.
  *   Customer Impact: Trusted by leading surveillance and security companies (e.g., Rhombus Security, Actuate, Milestone Systems) to accelerate the cycle of finding relevant data, annotating it, and deploying models.
  *   Strategic Advantage: Reduces time-to-market for AI-powered vision systems by streamlining data preparation and annotation processes.

Cisco Use Case:
Encord can help Cisco advance its AI-driven video analytics and smart security solutions by:

  *   Accelerating model development: Automate annotation workflows for video streams from Cisco’s security cameras and IoT devices, reducing manual effort and speeding up deployment.
  *   Improving threat detection: Enable Cisco to curate large-scale video datasets for anomaly detection and predictive security analytics across platforms like Meraki and SecureX.
  *   Enhancing multimodal AI capabilities: Support Cisco’s initiatives in combining video, sensor, and metadata for advanced situational awareness in
